newsitem.title: EGYPT: Arafat arrives in Egypt from Saudi Arabia.
newsitem.headline: Arafat arrives in Egypt from Saudi Arabia.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat arrived in Cairo on Wednesday from Saudi Arabia, airport sources said.
He was expected to meet Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak.

Arafat had held talks in Saudi with King Fahd on the PLO-Israeli peace process. He said on Monday that he was determined to see agreed-upon self-rule deals with Israel implemented and warned Palestinians would not accept something imposed on them.
